summary: Frontend verified for new Monitor tabs 'Bases de datos' + 'Servicios & Apps' and MySQL config fields on 'Plesk & MySQL'. Super admin login OK, /app/monitor renders 6 tabs (Sistema, Bases de datos, Servicios & Apps, Dominios & Ataques, Cambios de archivos, Plesk & MySQL). Databases tab: db-mongo shows real data (MongoDB v7.0.40, 31.3 MB, 4/405 conexiones, 21m uptime, list of DBs test_database/config/local/admin + Ops counters). db-mysql shows expected 'no configurado' message without crashing. Services tab: 5 app cards found (tramilex, goroky, ingresoqr, gym24, mvg) each with 'Sin servicios systemd detectados' (expected in preview) + 'Puertos a la escucha' section rendered with 1 listening port (0.0.0.0:* python/uvicorn). monitor-refresh works on both new tabs. Plesk & MySQL tab: plesk-host, plesk-apikey and all mysql-host/mysql-port/mysql-user/mysql-pw fields are editable; plesk-save button clicks and triggers save+test without breaking UI. System tab regression OK (CPU/RAM/Swap/Uptime keywords present). No console/page errors, no error-class elements.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ServerMonitor now has 6 tabs. New endpoints /api/admin/monitor/databases and /services rendered correctly in preview. MongoDB real data shows on db-mongo card. MySQL and systemd apps degrade gracefully in preview as expected. Plesk & MySQL config form contains both plesk-* and mysql-* editable fields plus plesk-save action.
